summary: First iteration full-stack testing for Sambhrama. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed (health, portfolio incl. category filter, testimonials, vendors, booking create + 422 validation, newsletter idempotency, login valid/invalid, /me with+without cookie, logout cookie-clear, admin stats, admin bookings list, booking status update PUT, portfolio CRUD, testimonial create+delete, vendor CRUD). Frontend: landing renders, portfolio category filter (Wedding) shows filtered items, lightbox opens+closes, 3-step booking wizard submits and shows success view + sonner toast, newsletter footer signup works with success toast, /admin/login shows error for invalid creds and redirects to /admin on valid creds, all 5 admin tabs (overview/bookings/portfolio/testimonials/vendors) present and switchable, logout returns to /admin/login, mobile menu (≤768px) opens via nav-mobile-toggle and shows Services/Portfolio/About/Testimonials/Contact. Resend email is correctly best-effort skipped (RESEND_API_KEY blank) and booking POST still returns 201.

issues: Nav links 'Partners' and 'FAQ' would require IDs `#partners` and `#faq` for smooth-scroll anchors; the components render but the section root elements appear to not carry those ids. Nav uses 'Testimonials' and 'Contact' which work. Non-blocking.

console_warnings: React warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' (likely setState during render — check AuthContext.jsx or initial redirect logic in AdminLogin/AdminDashboard).

Hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — a Select/option somewhere is wrapping option children in a span (likely in a shadcn Select used inside admin forms or booking budget). Cosmetic, not blocking.
action_items: (Optional) Add id='partners' to Partners section and id='faq' to FAQ section so Nav smooth-scroll matches link names.
(Optional) Fix React 'setState during render' warning — trace via React DevTools; likely a navigate() call inside render rather than useEffect.
(Optional) Fix <span> inside <option> hydration warning by ensuring native <option> children are plain text only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS allow_origins hardcodes localhost:3000 in addition to FRONTEND_URL env. Acceptable for preview but consider using CORS_ORIGINS env (which is already present in .env as '*' but unused).
Booking POST schedules send_booking_email via asyncio.create_task — fine, but no retry/dead-letter; acceptable for best-effort.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes if password changed (idempotent). Good.
JWT cookie is SameSite=None Secure — required for cross-site preview URLs. Good.
All public list endpoints exclude `_id`. Good.
No file-size violations; server.py is ~630 lines — acceptable but could be split when more features land.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 8 portfolio items, 4 testimonials, 4 vendors and the admin user automatically on startup. Verified by GET responses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 backend pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_sambhrama.py pass. Frontend critical flows (landing, portfolio filter+lightbox, booking wizard, newsletter, admin login/dashboard tabs/logout, mobile menu) all verified via Playwright. Resend email is intentionally skipped because RESEND_API_KEY is blank — expected. Only minor cosmetic issues: two React console warnings (setState-during-render + <span> in <option>) and missing #partners/#faq anchor ids — none block functionality.
